clock_dir_past: Polish "po <hour>" == past the hour: "kwadrans po dziewiątej" == 09:15.
clock_dir_to: Polish "za <fraction> <hour>" == to/before the hour: "za kwadrans dziesiąta"
== a quarter to ten == 09:45.  Citation: Poradnia Językowa PWN (sjp.pwn.pl).
clock_fraction_15: Polish QUARTER runs the ordinary past/to clock (NOT toward-hour): "kwadrans
po dziewiątej" == a quarter PAST nine == 09:15, "za kwadrans dziesiąta" == a
quarter TO ten == 09:45.  Citation: Poradnia Językowa PWN (sjp.pwn.pl);
clock_fraction_30: Polish toward-hour HALF: "wpół do dziewiątej" == half toward nine == 08:30
(bare_half_to + toward_hour_12h; the "do" is the ordinary "to" connector).
NB Polish splits the system: only the HALF counts toward the coming hour;
the QUARTER uses the ordinary past/to reading (see clock_fraction_15), so
bare_quarter_to is deliberately NOT set.  Citation: Poradnia Językowa PWN
(sjp.pwn.pl) and PAN Wielki słownik języka polskiego (wsjp.pl), "wpół do".

daypart_afternoon_pl: dayPeriods format-wide afternoon1 is "po południu", the phrase a speaker
uses when placing an event; the stand-alone chart gives the bare noun
"popołudnie", which names the part of the day itself.  Both are listed,
with the locative the preposition governs.
daypart_evening_pl: Band boundaries: Unicode CLDR 47 Day Period Rules, locale pl
transcribed in chronologia/dayparts.py as the evening band.
Surface: adverb 'in the evening' (instrumental of wieczór) -- the deictic form these phrases use.
daypart_morning_pl: Band boundaries: Unicode CLDR 47 Day Period Rules, locale pl
transcribed in chronologia/dayparts.py as the morning band.
Surface: adverb 'in the morning' -- the deictic form these phrases use.
daypart_night_pl: dayPeriods format-wide night1 is "w nocy"; the stand-alone chart gives the
bare noun "noc".  The locative "nocy" carries the same reading after the
preposition and is listed so the phrase reads without it.

marker_half: Polish period noun "half" for "first/second half of <year>" (half_period).
"połowa": PWN, Słownik języka polskiego -- "połowa" = jedna z dwóch równych
"pół" is the bound/prefixal form kept for the clock half-hour path.
marker_last: Polish "last/previous" determiner, the full adjectival paradigm.  The temporal
phrase is locative in ordinary speech -- "w zeszłym tygodniu", "w ubiegłym
miesiącu", "w poprzednim roku" -- so listing the nominative alone left the
"poprzedni" and soft-stem "ostatni" ("ostatni piątek" = last Friday) follow
the regular adjective declension described in the PWN
marker_next: Polish "next/following" determiner, the full adjectival paradigm.  "w przyszłym
tygodniu" and "w następnym miesiącu" are locative, the ordinary spoken forms.
Regular adjective declension per the PWN inflection rules.
marker_ordlast: Polish "last" ordinal determiner, the soft-stem adjective paradigm "ostatni".
"ostatni poniedzialek maja" = last Monday of May.  PWN, odmiana "ostatni".
marker_quarter_word: The locative "kwartale" is the case the relative-quarter phrases take:

marker_this: Polish "this" demonstrative, the full pronominal paradigm.  "w tym tygodniu"
is the instrumental/locative "tym", "tego roku" the genitive.  The dative
"temu" is deliberately withheld: in Polish "temu" is the ago-marker ("dwa dni
temu"), so admitting it here would read a past offset as a present one.
Regular pronoun declension per the PWN inflection rules.
